Q : How do I start my nursing assignment introduction?

The tone is academic for the introduction and will outline the purpose, importance and shape of the assignment in very clear terms. Beginning with an overall context of the chosen subject that explains its relevance in nursing or healthcare practice, state objectives, e.g.:

  • Specific focus area, like patient safety, leadership or wound care.
  • Reasons why it matters in clinical settings in the UK, with references to current guidelines (like, say, NMC Code, NICE).
  • The concluding sentence of the introduction will be a summary of the content flow.

    • Example:

    “This paper critically explores the role of patient-centred communication in managing post-operative complications in elderly patients.”
